This '''Ice troll''' is encountered in [[Daemonheim]] with the [[Dungeoneering]] skill. (There is also a [[Thrower troll (Daemonheim)|thrower troll]], who is very similar but is lower in level and uses ranged attacks.) Casting water spells heals Ice trolls by around 40 life points.
